name: Deep block
engine: They sit deep and do not chase: runs and passes through at their box are resisted, and they rest after each attack.
about: An opponent build (play it against: ?opp=opp-deep-block). They sit deep and do not chase: your runs and passes through at the edge of their box and in it are +1 to them, and after every attack of yours without a shot their defence rests and gets 10 stamina back. It taxes Wear them down (the runs and the fatigue), not closes it.
